title: Structured output: JSON, XML, Markdown and CSV

videos.script: So far every reply in this course was read by a person. {{person}} A person forgives a lot. A sentence before the answer, a word in capitals, a list where a table was asked for. {{forgive}} A program forgives nothing. It wants the label in one place, the number as a number, and nothing else around them. {{program}} This lesson is about asking a model for text a program can read. {{formats}} JSON for records, tags around the part you extract, Markdown for people, and CSV for rows. {{four}} You ask your own model, give real parsers what it sends back, and watch which ones they refuse. {{parsers}} The worst one is refused by nobody. It parses, and the price is in the wrong column. {{worst}} Lesson 19 then checks each reply against a schema, and repairs the ones that fail. {{next}}
